subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this as a bundled provider harness with an adopted and security-reviewed bridge package, or require the Claude and GLM work to ship as external plugins through the existing plugin/ClawHub path?
rationale: The decision determines the acceptable dependency owner, whether provider-specific auth and session semantics may enter core, and whether a shared public harness API should exist; these are product and security-boundary choices, not mechanical contributor fixes.

options.title: Externalize the harnesses
options.body: Keep core plugin-agnostic and package the Claude and GLM integrations as external plugins using existing supported seams, with their bridge dependencies and state ownership outside the core distribution.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded bundled design
options.body: Adopt or republish the bridge under an approved owner, authorize its dependency provenance, and split generic SDK/core seams from the provider-owned extension implementation before merge.

options.title: Decline this architecture
options.body: Close the proposal in favor of improving an existing Claude CLI, ACP, or provider route if maintainers do not want another app-server harness family.

recommendation.title: Externalize the harnesses
recommendation.body: Keep core plugin-agnostic and package the Claude and GLM integrations as external plugins using existing supported seams, with their bridge dependencies and state ownership outside the core distribution.

likelyOwner.reason: The available branch history attributes several feature-shape decisions to Eddie, but official ownership should be confirmed through normal repository routing.
